tone.target: dark post-punk crunch with chorusy ambience
tone.profile: dark post-punk crunch with chorusy ambience
tone.summary: A tight, crunchy signal chain using a British amp model (AC30) combined with an OD boost for mid-heavy grit, followed by Chorus and subtle delay/reverb to achieve the dark, atmospheric post-punk sound.
corrections: name chorus as likely key texture

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide mid-heavy grit and tight rhythmic crunch without excessive brightness.
blocks.gap: The source suggests a Tube Screamer, but Green OD is the closest available model for controlled, mid-focused boost/grit.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more open tone than desired.

blocks.purpose: Add foundational crunch and grit for the post-punk texture.
blocks.gap: No specific distortion model was requested, but RAT-style provides a tight, aggressive mid-range bite suitable for alternative rock.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the requested Marshall/AC30 type amp tone, emphasizing mids.
